entities.name: Alexey Medvedev
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexey Sidorovich Medvedev was a Soviet-Russian heavyweight weightlifter who won European titles in 1956 and 1958 and world titles in 1957 and 1958. On 15 March 1959, he set a world record in the snatch.
